incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — Canary cluster us-west-2: elevated 5xx and p95 latency on /v1/generate. Kernel selector fell back to compatibility path. Paging @eng-oncall.

alice.chen: seeing it in dashboards — p95 jumped from 120ms -> 1.8s, throughput dropped ~30% on canary slice. Error spike aligned with 2023-11-03T12:34:xx deploy.

samir.khan: potentially related to the new routing / batching mesh we rolled earlier. Kernel fallback log shows: `kernel_selector: fallback_to_compat_cpu (reason=kernel_missing)`

jamie.rivers: confirming canary only? any customer-facing errors?

incident-bot: Customer impact: ~2% global error rate increase. Top affected tenants: AcmeCorp, Lumen.AI (higher request density). Attach: https://dashboards.redwood/err/1729999999 (red).

alice.chen: quick mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag `new-mesh-batching` off in canary 2) if still bad, rollback canary to previous revision 3) open kill-switch if rollout orchestrator not cooperating.

samir.khan: agree. I can flip flag. Command: ```rctl feature set new-mesh-batching false --env canary --reason "kernel-fallback spike"```

jamie.rivers: +1 do it. Also prepare rollback command if flip doesn't reduce 5xx: ```deployctl promote --env canary --revision 2023-11-03-12-00````

alice.chen: running feature flip now. Will post ops output.

alice.chen: (ops output) ```OK: feature new-mesh-batching=false applied to canary pool (3/3 hosts)
Checking health: 30s... p95: 1.8s -> 1.1s, errors: 2.0% -> 1.1%``` :white_check_mark:

samir.khan: nice, partial improvement. Can we hold traffic for 10m and observe? If errors drift back up, proceed to rollback.

jamie.rivers: starting a short traffic hold and increased logging for kernel-selector. Added this sampling rule in prod: ```logcfg add-sample kernel_selector --rate 1% --env canary```

incident-bot: Incident severity: S2 -> S1 if customer impact grows. Current S2. Paging schedule: @alice.chen primary, @leah.ops on-call backup.

leah.ops: I see the handoff. I'll take over if it continues. Summary for handoff: feature flip reduced errors ~45% and p95 improved but still above baseline. Root cause likely kernel selection + missing optimized kernel for new batching path. Next steps: block rollout, schedule production rollback window, notify CS for affected tenants.

alice.chen: agreed — I'm marking rollout as blocked and opening rollback window for 5 minutes if we see >1.5% errors. Also applied a traffic split to route 0% to new canary slice (manual route swap).

samir.khan: filing quick bug: `kernel-selector` should fallback to compatible GPU kernel, not CPU, and we need fail-open vs fail-silent metrics — assigning to eng-runtime.

jamie.rivers: notifying CS: `@customersupport heads-up: some requests for AcmeCorp & Lumen.AI may have degraded performance between 12:34-12:50 UTC; mitigation in progress (feature flag flip).`

incident-bot: NOTE: Rollback not yet executed. Keep this channel updated. If you need kill-switch at platform level: `platformctl kill-flag set rollout_canary_20231103 true`

leah.ops: taking over on-call now (handoff). If errors resurge, I'll run the rollback. Logging summary and capture uploaded to: https://logs.redwood/capture/1729999999.

alice.chen: handing off complete — leaving post-action checklist in ops-docs. Will follow up for postmortem.

samir.khan: proposed postmortem items: kernel artifact publishing verification, feature-flag safety check before rollout, additional canary traffic throttling guard.

leah.ops: final status at 12:58 UTC: feature flag flip held; p95 back to ~140ms for most traffic, errors down to baseline. Marking incident as mitigated and initiating post-incident review. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED — auto-close in 2h unless re-opened.

leah.ops: filing short incident report and scheduling RCA meeting for tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
